            "text": "**币种差异**：",
            "lineNumber": 751
          },
          {
            "text": "- BTC/ETH：可以使用较大倍数（3.0-4.0倍），趋势持续性好",
            "lineNumber": 752
          },
          {
            "text": "- 山寨币：建议使用较小倍数（2.5-3.5倍），快速止盈锁定利润",
            "lineNumber": 753
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 754
          },
          {
            "text": "### 实战示例",
            "lineNumber": 755
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 756
          },
          {
            "text": "**示例1：BTC 高波动突破做多**",
            "lineNumber": 757
          },
          {
            "text": "- 当前 ATR: 450 USDT，平均 ATR: 300 USDT（1.5倍平均，高波动）",
            "lineNumber": 758
          },
          {
            "text": "- 入场价: 95000 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 759
          },
          {
            "text": "- 市场状态: 4h强上升趋势，OI持续增加，机构资金流入",
            "lineNumber": 760
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止损倍数选择: 2.5倍（高波动+BTC）",
            "lineNumber": 761
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止损价: 95000 - 2.5×450 = 93875 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 762
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止盈倍数选择: 4.0倍（强趋势+BTC）",
            "lineNumber": 763
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止盈价: 95000 + 4.0×450 = 96800 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 764
          },
          {
            "text": "- 理由: BTC高波动用大倍数避免震出，强趋势让利润充分奔跑",
            "lineNumber": 765
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 766
          },
          {
            "text": "**示例2：山寨币正常波动做多**",
            "lineNumber": 767
          },
          {
            "text": "- 当前 ATR: 0.05 USDT，平均 ATR: 0.05 USDT（1.0倍平均，正常波动）",
            "lineNumber": 768
          },
          {
            "text": "- 入场价: 1.50 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 769
          },
          {
            "text": "- 市场状态: 1h上升趋势，OI增加，但4h震荡",
            "lineNumber": 770
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止损倍数选择: 1.8倍（正常波动+山寨币）",
            "lineNumber": 771
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止损价: 1.50 - 1.8×0.05 = 1.41 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 772
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止盈倍数选择: 3.0倍（正常趋势+山寨币）",
            "lineNumber": 773
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止盈价: 1.50 + 3.0×0.05 = 1.65 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 774
          },
          {
            "text": "- 理由: 山寨币波动大用中等倍数，4h震荡所以止盈不宜过大",
            "lineNumber": 775
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 776
          },
          {
            "text": "**示例3：小市值币低波动做多**",
            "lineNumber": 777
          },
          {
            "text": "- 当前 ATR: 0.008 USDT，平均 ATR: 0.012 USDT（0.67倍平均，低波动）",
            "lineNumber": 778
          },
          {
            "text": "- 入场价: 0.50 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 779
          },
          {
            "text": "- 市场状态: 15m突破，但1h和4h方向不明",
            "lineNumber": 780
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止损倍数选择: 1.5倍（低波动+小市值+弱趋势）",
            "lineNumber": 781
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止损价: 0.50 - 1.5×0.008 = 0.488 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 782
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止盈倍数选择: 2.5倍（弱趋势+快速止盈）",
            "lineNumber": 783
          },
          {
            "text": "- 止盈价: 0.50 + 2.5×0.008 = 0.52 USDT",
            "lineNumber": 784
          },
          {
            "text": "- 理由: 低波动收紧止损，弱趋势快速止盈避免反转",
            "lineNumber": 785
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 786
          },
          {
            "text": "### 系统执行方式（无需 AI 额外操作）",
            "lineNumber": 787
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 788
          },
          {
            "text": "- **连续确认**：止损条件需**连续 N 个检查周期**（策略可配置，如 2 周期）都满足后才会执行平仓，单根 K 线触及止损价不会立即平仓，可减少假跌破触发。",
            "lineNumber": 789
          },
          {
            "text": "- **高波动宽容**：当「当前 ATR &gt; 长期 ATR×阈值」时，系统会自动使用更宽的 ATR 止损倍数，并多要求 1 个确认周期再执行，高波动时更宽容、减少噪音触发。",
            "lineNumber": 790
          },
          {
            "text": "- 你只需在开仓时设定合理的止损/止盈价与倍数，无需因「价格一度触及止损」就建议平仓；是否执行由策略按上述规则自动处理。",
            "lineNumber": 791
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 792
          },
          {
            "text": "### 重要提醒",
            "lineNumber": 793
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 794
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **必须在允许范围内选择**: 止损1.5-2.5倍，止盈2.5-4.0倍，不能超出范围",
            "lineNumber": 795
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **综合考虑多个因素**: 波动率、币种特性、趋势强度、多周期共振",
            "lineNumber": 796
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **动态调整**: 不同市场状态使用不同倍数，不要固定使用某个值",
            "lineNumber": 797
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **风险优先**: 不确定时选择较小倍数，控制风险",
            "lineNumber": 798
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **记录理由**: 在reasoning中必须明确写出：（1）**止损价**与**止盈价**及对应**ATR倍数**（如：止损1.8×ATR=某价，止盈3×ATR=某价）；（2）**ATR周期**（如3m/15m）；（3）**盈亏比**（开仓时必写：如「盈亏比 6.8:1（止盈幅度÷止损幅度）」），便于与开仓卡片上的盈亏比对照；（4）若策略启用**追踪止损（分层）**，说明「追踪止损由策略执行」；（5）若策略启用**分层止盈**，说明「分层止盈由策略执行」及各档位（如3%平33%、5%平50%）。系统无固定初始止损，仅按动态/ATR/追踪止损执行。",
            "lineNumber": 799
          },
          {
            "text": "6. **策略合理性**: 未设置最小持仓时间易导致「开仓即平仓」，建议配置 MinHoldMinutes（如 5 分钟）后再允许动态止损/止盈触发",
            "lineNumber": 800
          },
          {
            "text": "7. **对已有持仓的平仓建议**: 实际止盈与止损由**策略动态执行**（最小持仓、追踪止损、ATR、分层止盈）。不要仅因「亏损接近某固定%」或「峰值回撤某%」就建议平仓；若建议 close_long/close_short，须基于**强烈看反转或结构破坏**等理由，并在 reasoning 中说明是否已过最小持仓、是否与策略动态规则一致。",
            "lineNumber": 801
          },
          {
            "text": "8. **结构破坏即减仓**: 一旦 1h 收盘价跌破 EMA20（多单）或升破 EMA20（空单），可视为结构破坏，即可建议平仓，不必等 4h 完全转势，以减小单笔亏损。",
            "lineNumber": 802
          },
          {
            "text": "9. **明确反转可反手**: 当多周期与 OI 已明确转空（当前持多）或转多（当前持空）时，可在**同一计划**中对同一标的输出两条决策：先 close_long 再 open_short（或先 close_short 再 open_long）。系统会先执行平仓再执行开仓；反手新仓需重新设定止损、止盈与仓位，并在 reasoning 中说明反手理由。",
            "lineNumber": 803
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 804
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 805
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 806
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 807
          },
          {
            "text": "// getMarketRegimeGuideEN 获取英文市场状态识别指南",
            "lineNumber": 808
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3319421112537384
    },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\kernel\\prompt_builder.go",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 194,
            "column": 40
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 261
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (pb *PromptBuilder) buildSystemPromptEN() string {",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn &#96;You are a professional quantitative trading AI assistant responsible for analyzing market data and making trading decisions.",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "## Your Mission",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Analyze Account Status**: Evaluate current risk level, margin usage, and positions",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Analyze Current Positions**: Assess if trend continues, check for structural breaks",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Analyze Candidate Coins**: Assess new trading opportunities using technical analysis and capital flows",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Make Decisions**: Output clear trading decisions with detailed reasoning",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚠️ Core Principle: Stop-Loss/Take-Profit is Executed by Strategy",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "**The system has configured dynamic SL/TP strategies** (trailing stop, ATR stop, scaled take-profit). These strategies automatically monitor and execute closes.",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "### Division of Responsibilities",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Your job**: Determine trend direction, choose entry timing, assess risk, decide whether to open new positions",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Strategy's job**: Automatically execute stop-loss/take-profit (trailing stop, ATR stop, scaled TP); execution uses confirm cycles and is more tolerant in high volatility—do not recommend closing solely because one bar touched the stop level. On structure break (e.g. 1h close below/above EMA20) you may recommend closing to reduce loss; on clear reversal you may close then open the opposite direction in the same plan.",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "### Closing Existing Positions",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Default to HOLD**: Unless there are extreme signals, let the strategy manage SL/TP automatically",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Only recommend closing in these extreme cases**:",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. Key support/resistance broken, or **1h close below EMA20 (longs) / above EMA20 (shorts)**—structure break, close early to reduce loss",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. Multi-timeframe (1h+4h) trend reversal simultaneously",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. Major bearish news or black swan event",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "  4. Extreme RSI overbought(&gt;85)/oversold(&lt;15) + volume divergence",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Flip on clear reversal**: If multi-timeframe and OI clearly reversed, in the same plan you may output close_long then open_short (or close_short then open_long) for that symbol; system executes close first then open; set new SL/TP for the new position",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Do NOT close for these reasons**:",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Short-term oscillation or normal pullback",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Floating loss within strategy's stop-loss range",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Just \"feeling risky\" without specific technical signals",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "## Decision Principles",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "### Risk First",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "- Margin usage must not exceed 30%",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "- Capital protection first, profit second",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "### Trend Following",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "- Only enter when trends align across multiple timeframes",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use Open Interest (OI) changes to validate capital flow authenticity",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "- OI up + Price up = Strong bullish trend",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "- OI down + Price up = Shorts covering (potential reversal)",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "### Patient Holding",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "- After opening, trust the strategy; don't trade frequently due to short-term volatility",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "- Frequent trading in ranging markets accumulates fee losses",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "- Let profits run; let trailing stop lock in profits",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "## Output Format Requirements",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "**Must** use the following JSON format:",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96; + \"&#96;&#96;&#96;json\" + &#96;",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "[",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "  {",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"symbol\": \"BTCUSDT\",",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"action\": \"HOLD|PARTIAL_CLOSE|FULL_CLOSE|ADD_POSITION|OPEN_NEW|WAIT\",",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"leverage\": 3,",
            "lineNumber": 254

          {
            "text": "func getMultiTimeframeGuideEN() string {",
            "lineNumber": 954
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn &#96;### Timeframe Hierarchy",
            "lineNumber": 955
          },
          {
            "text": "- **15m**: Precise entry timing, find optimal entry points",
            "lineNumber": 956
          },
          {
            "text": "- **1h**: Trend confirmation, determine short-term trend direction",
            "lineNumber": 957
          },
          {
            "text": "- **4h**: Major trend assessment, establish primary trend direction",
            "lineNumber": 958
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 959
          },
          {
            "text": "### Analysis Principles",
            "lineNumber": 960
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Higher timeframe sets direction**: Check 4h first to determine major trend (long/short/wait)",
            "lineNumber": 961
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Medium timeframe finds timing**: Check 1h to confirm short-term trend aligns with major trend",
            "lineNumber": 962
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Lower timeframe precise entry**: Check 15m last to find specific entry point",
            "lineNumber": 963
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 964
          },
          {
            "text": "### Long/Short Assessment",
            "lineNumber": 965
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Strong Bullish**: 4h up + 1h up + 15m up (triple timeframe alignment)",
            "lineNumber": 966
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Bullish**: 4h up + 1h up + 15m sideways/pullback (wait for 15m to turn bullish)",
            "lineNumber": 967
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Cautiously Bullish**: 4h up + 1h sideways + 15m up (1h may turn bullish)",
            "lineNumber": 968
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Wait**: 4h sideways OR timeframes not aligned",
            "lineNumber": 969
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Cautiously Bearish**: 4h down + 1h sideways + 15m down (1h may turn bearish)",
            "lineNumber": 970
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Bearish**: 4h down + 1h down + 15m sideways/bounce (wait for 15m to turn bearish)",
            "lineNumber": 971
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Strong Bearish**: 4h down + 1h down + 15m down (triple timeframe alignment)",
            "lineNumber": 972
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 973
          },
          {
            "text": "### Practical Example",
            "lineNumber": 974
          },
          {
            "text": "**Scenario**: 4h strong uptrend, 1h just broke above EMA20, 15m pulling back to EMA20",
            "lineNumber": 975
          },
          {
            "text": "**Assessment**: Major trend up, short-term breakout confirmed, minor pullback offers entry",
            "lineNumber": 976
          },
          {
            "text": "**Action**: Go long near 15m EMA20, stop-loss below 15m EMA20",
            "lineNumber": 977
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 978
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 979
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 980
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 981
          },
          {
            "text": "// ========== 交易场景示例 ==========",
            "lineNumber": 982
          },

            "lineNumber": 983

            "text": "\tif decision != nil {",

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "\tif err != nil {",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "// ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "// Market Data Fetching",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "// ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "// fetchMarketDataWithStrategy fetches market data using strategy config (multiple timeframes)",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "func fetchMarketDataWithStrategy(ctx *Context, engine *StrategyEngine) error {",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "\tconfig := engine.GetConfig()",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "\tctx.MarketDataMap = make(map[string]*market.Data)",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "\ttimeframes := config.Indicators.Klines.SelectedTimeframes",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "\tprimaryTimeframe := config.Indicators.Klines.PrimaryTimeframe",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "\tklineCount := config.Indicators.Klines.PrimaryCount",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Compatible with old configuration",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif len(timeframes) == 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif primaryTimeframe != \"\" {",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\ttimeframes = append(timeframes, primaryTimeframe)",
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t} else {",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\ttimeframes = append(timeframes, \"3m\")",
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif config.Indicators.Klines.LongerTimeframe != \"\" {",
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\ttimeframes = append(timeframes, config.Indicators.Klines.LongerTimeframe)",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif primaryTimeframe == \"\" {",
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tprimaryTimeframe = timeframes[0]",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif klineCount &lt;= 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tklineCount = 30",
            "lineNumber": 406
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "text": "\tlogger.Infof(\"📊 Strategy timeframes: %v, Primary: %s, Kline count: %d\", timeframes, primaryTimeframe, klineCount)",
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. First fetch data for position coins (must fetch)",
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "text": "\tfor _, pos := range ctx.Positions {",
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tdata, err := market.GetWithTimeframes(pos.Symbol, timeframes, primaryTimeframe, klineCount)",
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif err != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tlogger.Infof(\"⚠️  Failed to fetch market data for position %s: %v\", pos.Symbol, err)",
            "lineNumber": 415
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tcontinue",
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 417
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tctx.MarketDataMap[pos.Symbol] = data",
            "lineNumber": 418
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 419
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 420
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Fetch data for candidate coins (cap count to control prompt size / token usage)",
            "lineNumber": 421
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 回测只对 r.cfg.Symbols 拉行情（通常 3～5 个），实盘/模拟候选列表可能很多，故此处限制写入 prompt 的候选数，减轻 token 差距",
            "lineNumber": 422
          },
          {
            "text": "\tpositionSymbols := make(map[string]bool)",
            "lineNumber": 423
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2503890097141266

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\kernel\\stop_loss.go",

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (c *StopLossChecker) CheckStopLoss(",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "\tposition *PositionInfo,",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcurrentPrice float64,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "\thighestPrice float64, // highest price since entry (for trailing stop)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "\tatr float64, // current ATR value (e.g. 14)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "\tatrLong float64, // longer-period ATR for volatility regime (0 = disable tolerance)",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsupportLevel float64, // support level (0 if not available)",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": ") *StopLossSignal {",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c == nil || c.config == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn &amp;StopLossSignal{Triggered: false}",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsignals := make([]*StopLossSignal, 0)",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. Check initial fixed stop loss only when configured (InitialStopPercent &gt; 0). Removed as default; use dynamic/ATR/trailing only when 0.",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c.config.InitialStopPercent &gt; 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif signal := c.checkInitialStop(position, currentPrice); signal.Triggered {",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsignals = append(signals, signal)",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Check trailing stop (if enabled)",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c.config.TrailingEnabled != nil &amp;&amp; *c.config.TrailingEnabled {",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif signal := c.checkTrailingStop(position, currentPrice, highestPrice); signal.Triggered {",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsignals = append(signals, signal)",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 3. Check ATR stop (if enabled); pass atrLong for high-vol tolerance",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c.config.ATREnabled != nil &amp;&amp; *c.config.ATREnabled &amp;&amp; atr &gt; 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 68

          {
            "lineNumber": 921
          },
          {
            "text": "// ========== 多时间框架分析指南 ==========",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 923
          },
          {
            "text": "// getMultiTimeframeGuideZH 获取中文多时间框架分析指南",
            "lineNumber": 924
          },
          {
            "text": "func getMultiTimeframeGuideZH() string {",
            "lineNumber": 925
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn &#96;### 时间框架层级",
            "lineNumber": 926
          },
          {
            "text": "- **15m**: 精确入场时机，寻找最佳入场点",
            "lineNumber": 927
          },
          {
            "text": "- **1h**: 趋势确认，判断短期趋势方向",
            "lineNumber": 928
          },
          {
            "text": "- **4h**: 大趋势判断，确定主要趋势方向",
            "lineNumber": 929
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 930
          },
          {
            "text": "### 分析原则",
            "lineNumber": 931
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **大周期定方向**: 先看4h确定大趋势（做多/做空/观望）",
            "lineNumber": 932
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **中周期找时机**: 再看1h确认短期趋势是否与大趋势一致",
            "lineNumber": 933
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **小周期精确入场**: 最后看15m寻找具体入场点",
            "lineNumber": 934
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 935
          },
          {
            "text": "### 多空判断",
            "lineNumber": 936
          },
          {
            "text": "- **强烈看多**: 4h上升 + 1h上升 + 15m上升（三周期共振）",
            "lineNumber": 937
          },
          {
            "text": "- **看多**: 4h上升 + 1h上升 + 15m震荡/回调（等待15m转多）",
            "lineNumber": 938
          },
          {
            "text": "- **谨慎看多**: 4h上升 + 1h震荡 + 15m上升（1h可能转多）",
            "lineNumber": 939
          },
          {
            "text": "- **观望**: 4h震荡 或 各周期方向不一致",
            "lineNumber": 940
          },
          {
            "text": "- **谨慎看空**: 4h下降 + 1h震荡 + 15m下降（1h可能转空）",
            "lineNumber": 941
          },
          {
            "text": "- **看空**: 4h下降 + 1h下降 + 15m震荡/反弹（等待15m转空）",
            "lineNumber": 942
          },
          {
            "text": "- **强烈看空**: 4h下降 + 1h下降 + 15m下降（三周期共振）",
            "lineNumber": 943
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 944
          },
          {
            "text": "### 实战案例",
            "lineNumber": 945
          },
          {
            "text": "**场景**: 4h强上升趋势，1h刚突破EMA20，15m回调到EMA20附近",
            "lineNumber": 946
          },
          {
            "text": "**判断**: 大趋势向上，短期突破确认，小周期回调提供入场机会",
            "lineNumber": 947
          },
          {
            "text": "**操作**: 在15m EMA20附近做多，止损设在15m EMA20下方",
            "lineNumber": 948
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 949
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 950
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 951
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 952
          },
          {
            "text": "// getMultiTimeframeGuideEN 获取英文多时间框架分析指南",
            "lineNumber": 953
          },
          {
            "text": "func getMultiTimeframeGuideEN() string {",
            "lineNumber": 954
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn &#96;### Timeframe Hierarchy",
            "lineNumber": 955
          },
          {
            "text": "- **15m**: Precise entry timing, find optimal entry points",
            "lineNumber": 956
          },
          {
            "text": "- **1h**: Trend confirmation, determine short-term trend direction",
            "lineNumber": 957
          },
          {
            "text": "- **4h**: Major trend assessment, establish primary trend direction",
            "lineNumber": 958
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 959
          },
          {
            "text": "### Analysis Principles",
            "lineNumber": 960
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Higher timeframe sets direction**: Check 4h first to determine major trend (long/short/wait)",
            "lineNumber": 961
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Medium timeframe finds timing**: Check 1h to confirm short-term trend aligns with major trend",
            "lineNumber": 962
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Lower timeframe precise entry**: Check 15m last to find specific entry point",
            "lineNumber": 963
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 964
          },
          {
            "text": "### Long/Short Assessment",
            "lineNumber": 965
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Strong Bullish**: 4h up + 1h up + 15m up (triple timeframe alignment)",
            "lineNumber": 966
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Bullish**: 4h up + 1h up + 15m sideways/pullback (wait for 15m to turn bullish)",
            "lineNumber": 967
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Cautiously Bullish**: 4h up + 1h sideways + 15m up (1h may turn bullish)",
            "lineNumber": 968
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Wait**: 4h sideways OR timeframes not aligned",
            "lineNumber": 969
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Cautiously Bearish**: 4h down + 1h sideways + 15m down (1h may turn bearish)",
            "lineNumber": 970
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Bearish**: 4h down + 1h down + 15m sideways/bounce (wait for 15m to turn bearish)",
            "lineNumber": 971
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Strong Bearish**: 4h down + 1h down + 15m down (triple timeframe alignment)",
            "lineNumber": 972
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 973
          },
          {
            "text": "### Practical Example",
            "lineNumber": 974
          },
          {
            "text": "**Scenario**: 4h strong uptrend, 1h just broke above EMA20, 15m pulling back to EMA20",
            "lineNumber": 975
          },
          {
            "text": "**Assessment**: Major trend up, short-term breakout confirmed, minor pullback offers entry",
            "lineNumber": 976
          },
          {
            "text": "**Action**: Go long near 15m EMA20, stop-loss below 15m EMA20",
            "lineNumber": 977
          }
        ]
      },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (e *StrategyEngine) BuildSystemPrompt(accountEquity float64, variant string) string {",
            "lineNumber": 985
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar sb strings.Builder",
            "lineNumber": 986
          },
          {
            "text": "\triskControl := e.config.RiskControl",
            "lineNumber": 987
          },
          {
            "text": "\tpromptSections := e.config.PromptSections",
            "lineNumber": 988
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 989
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 0. Data Dictionary &amp; Schema (static content, will be cached)",
            "lineNumber": 990
          },
          {
            "text": "\tlang := e.GetLanguage()",
            "lineNumber": 991
          },
          {
            "text": "\tschemaPrompt := GetSchemaPrompt(lang)",
            "lineNumber": 992
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(schemaPrompt)",
            "lineNumber": 993
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 994
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"---\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 995
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 996
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. Role definition (editable)",
            "lineNumber": 997
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif promptSections.RoleDefinition != \"\" {",
            "lineNumber": 998
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(promptSections.RoleDefinition)",
            "lineNumber": 999
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1000
          },
          {
            "text": "\t} else {",
            "lineNumber": 1001
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"# You are a professional cryptocurrency trading AI\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1002
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"Your task is to make trading decisions based on provided market data.\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1003
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1004
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1005
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Trading mode variant",
            "lineNumber": 1006
          },
          {
            "text": "\tswitch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(variant)) {",
            "lineNumber": 1007
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"aggressive\":",
            "lineNumber": 1008
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"## Mode: Aggressive\\n- Prioritize capturing trend breakouts, can build positions in batches when confidence ≥ 70\\n- Allow higher positions, but must strictly set stop-loss and explain risk-reward ratio\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1009
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"conservative\":",
            "lineNumber": 1010
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"## Mode: Conservative\\n- Only open positions when multiple signals resonate\\n- Prioritize cash preservation, must pause for multiple periods after consecutive losses\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1011
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"scalping\":",
            "lineNumber": 1012
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"## Mode: Scalping\\n- Focus on short-term momentum, smaller profit targets but require quick action\\n- If price doesn't move as expected within two bars, immediately reduce position or stop-loss\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1013
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1014
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1015
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 3. Hard constraints (risk control)",
            "lineNumber": 1016
          },
          {
            "text": "\tbtcEthPosValueRatio := riskControl.BTCETHMaxPositionValueRatio",
            "lineNumber": 1017
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif btcEthPosValueRatio &lt;= 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 1018
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tbtcEthPosValueRatio = 5.0",
            "lineNumber": 1019
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1020
          },
          {
            "text": "\taltcoinPosValueRatio := riskControl.AltcoinMaxPositionValueRatio",
            "lineNumber": 1021
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif altcoinPosValueRatio &lt;= 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 1022
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\taltcoinPosValueRatio = 1.0",
            "lineNumber": 1023
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1024
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1025
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"# Hard Constraints (Risk Control)\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1026
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"## CODE ENFORCED (Backend validation, cannot be bypassed):\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1027
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"- Max Positions: %d coins simultaneously\\n\", riskControl.MaxPositions))",
            "lineNumber": 1028
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString",
            "lineNumber": 1029
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.233132004737854
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\kernel\\prompt_builder.go",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (pb *PromptBuilder) buildSystemPromptZH() string {",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn &#96;你是一个专业的量化交易AI助手，负责分析市场数据并做出交易决策。",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "## 你的任务",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **分析账户状态**: 评估当前风险水平、保证金使用率、持仓情况",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **分析当前持仓**: 评估趋势是否延续，是否有结构性破坏",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **分析候选币种**: 评估新的交易机会，结合技术分析和资金流向",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **做出决策**: 输出明确的交易决策，包含详细的推理过程",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚠️ 核心原则：止盈止损由策略自动执行",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "**系统已配置动态止盈止损策略**（追踪止损、ATR止损、分层止盈等），这些策略会自动监控并执行平仓。",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "### 你的职责分工",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- **你负责**: 判断趋势方向、选择开仓时机、评估风险、决定是否开新仓",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- **策略负责**: 自动执行止盈止损（追踪止损、ATR止损、分层止盈）；执行时会连续多周期确认再止损、高波动时更宽容，无需因单根K线触及止损就建议平仓。结构破坏（如1h收盘跌破/升破EMA20）时可建议平仓以减小亏损；明确反转时可对同一标的在同一计划中先平仓再反手开反向仓。",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "### 对已有持仓的平仓建议",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "- **默认持有 (HOLD)**: 除非有极端信号，否则让策略自动管理止盈止损",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "- **只在以下极端情况才建议平仓**:",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. 关键支撑/阻力被突破，或 **1h 收盘跌破 EMA20（多单）/ 升破 EMA20（空单）**——结构破坏，可早平仓减小亏损",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. 多周期（1h+4h）趋势同时反转",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. 重大利空消息或黑天鹅事件",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "  4. RSI极端超买(&gt;85)/超卖(&lt;15) + 放量背离",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "- **明确反转可反手**: 若多周期与 OI 已明确反转，可在同一计划中对该标的输出先 close_long 再 open_short（或先 close_short 再 open_long），系统会先平后开；反手新仓需重新设定止损止盈",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "- **不要因为以下原因主动平仓**:",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 短期震荡或正常回调",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 浮亏在策略止损范围内",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 仅因\"感觉风险高\"而没有具体技术信号",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "## 决策原则",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "### 风险优先",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "- 保证金使用率不得超过30%",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "- 优先保护资本，再考虑盈利",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### 顺势交易",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "- 只在多个时间框架趋势一致时进场",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "- 结合持仓量(OI)变化判断资金流向真实性",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "- OI增加+价格上涨 = 强多头趋势",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "- OI减少+价格上涨 = 空头平仓（可能反转）",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "### 耐心持仓",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "- 开仓后信任策略，不要因短期波动频繁进出",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "- 震荡行情中频繁交易会累积手续费损失",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "- 让利润奔跑，让策略的追踪止损锁定利润",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "## 输出格式要求",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "**必须**使用以下JSON格式输出决策：",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96; + \"&#96;&#96;&#96;json\" + &#96;",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "[",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "  {",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"symbol\": \"BTCUSDT\",",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"action\": \"HOLD|PARTIAL_CLOSE|FULL_CLOSE|ADD_POSITION|OPEN_NEW|WAIT\",",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"leverage\": 3,",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"position_size_usd\": 1000,",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"stop_loss\": 42000,",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"take_profit\": 48000,",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"confidence\": 85,",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"reasoning\": \"详细的推理过程，说明为什么做出这个决策\"",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "]",
            "lineNumber": 110
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2266114056110382
    },

      "codeBlock": {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func GetFullDecisionWithStrategy(ctx *Context, mcpClient mcp.AIClient, engine *StrategyEngine, variant, runID string) (*FullDecision, error) {",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif ctx == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"context is nil\")",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif engine == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tdefaultConfig := store.GetDefaultStrategyConfig(\"en\")",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tengine = NewStrategyEngine(&amp;defaultConfig)",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. Fetch market data using strategy config",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif len(ctx.MarketDataMap) == 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif err := fetchMarketDataWithStrategy(ctx, engine); err != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to fetch market data: %w\", err)",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Ensure OITopDataMap is initialized",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif ctx.OITopDataMap == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tctx.OITopDataMap = make(map[string]*OITopData)",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\toiPositions, err := engine.nofxosClient.GetOITopPositions()",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif err == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tfor _, pos := range oiPositions {",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tctx.OITopDataMap[pos.Symbol] = &amp;OITopData{",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tRank:              pos.Rank,",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tOIDeltaPercent:    pos.OIDeltaPercent,",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tOIDeltaValue:      pos.OIDeltaValue,",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tPriceDeltaPercent: pos.PriceDeltaPercent,",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Build System Prompt using strategy engine (includes Schema for caching)",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "\triskConfig := engine.GetRiskControlConfig()",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsystemPrompt := engine.BuildSystemPrompt(ctx.Account.TotalEquity, variant)",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 3. Build User Prompt using strategy engine",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "\tuserPrompt := engine.BuildUserPrompt(ctx)",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 4. Call AI API with prompt caching enabled",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "\taiCallStart := time.Now()",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "\taiResponse, err := callAIWithCaching(mcpClient, systemPrompt, userPrompt, runID)",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "\taiCallDuration := time.Since(aiCallStart)",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif err != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (e *StrategyEngine) formatMarketData(data *market.Data) string {",
            "lineNumber": 1608
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar sb strings.Builder",
            "lineNumber": 1609
          },
          {
            "text": "\tindicators := e.config.Indicators",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1611
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 明确标注币种",
            "lineNumber": 1612
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"=== %s Market Data ===\\n\\n\", data.Symbol))",
            "lineNumber": 1613
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 多周期涨跌提示，便于先定趋势再定多空（减少逆势与入场时机误判）",
            "lineNumber": 1614
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif data.PriceChange1h != 0 || data.PriceChange4h != 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 1615
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif e.GetLanguage() == LangChinese {",
            "lineNumber": 1616
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"多周期涨跌: 1h %+.2f%% 4h %+.2f%%（负=偏空 正=偏多，供趋势参考）\\n\\n\", data.PriceChange1h, data.PriceChange4h))",
            "lineNumber": 1617
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t} else {",
            "lineNumber": 1618
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"Multi-timeframe: 1h %+.2f%% 4h %+.2f%% (negative=bearish, positive=bullish, for trend reference)\\n\\n\", data.PriceChange1h, data.PriceChange4h))",
            "lineNumber": 1619
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1620
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1621
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"current_price = %.4f\", data.CurrentPrice))",
            "lineNumber": 1622
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1623
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif indicators.EnableEMA {",
            "lineNumber": 1624
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\", current_ema20 = %.3f\", data.CurrentEMA20))",
            "lineNumber": 1625
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1626
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1627
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif indicators.EnableMACD {",
            "lineNumber": 1628
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\", current_macd = %.3f\", data.CurrentMACD))",
            "lineNumber": 1629
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1630
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1631
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif indicators.EnableRSI {",
            "lineNumber": 1632
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\", current_rsi7 = %.3f\", data.CurrentRSI7))",
            "lineNumber": 1633
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1634
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1635
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1636
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1637
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif indicators.EnableOI || indicators.EnableFundingRate {",
            "lineNumber": 1638
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"Additional data for %s:\\n\\n\", data.Symbol))",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1640
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif indicators.EnableOI &amp;&amp; data.OpenInterest != nil {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"Open Interest: Latest: %.2f Average: %.2f\\n\\n\",",
            "lineNumber": 1642
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tdata.OpenInterest.Latest, data.OpenInterest.Average))",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1645
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 1650

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (c *StopLossChecker) checkTrailingStop(position *PositionInfo, currentPrice float64, highestPrice float64) *StopLossSignal {",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif len(c.config.TrailingLevels) == 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn &amp;StopLossSignal{Triggered: false}",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "\tentryPrice := position.EntryPrice",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "\t",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Calculate current profit percentage",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar profitPct float64",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif position.Side == \"long\" {",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif highestPrice &lt;= entryPrice {",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn &amp;StopLossSignal{Triggered: false} // no profit yet",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tprofitPct = ((highestPrice - entryPrice) / entryPrice) * 100",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "\t} else { // short",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif highestPrice &gt;= entryPrice {",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn &amp;StopLossSignal{Triggered: false} // no profit yet",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tprofitPct = ((entryPrice - highestPrice) / entryPrice) * 100",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Find the active trailing level (highest profit threshold reached) and tier index",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar activeLevel *store.TrailingStopLevel",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "\ttierIndex := 0",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "\tfor i := range c.config.TrailingLevels {",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tlevel := &amp;c.config.TrailingLevels[i]",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif profitPct &gt;= level.ProfitThreshold {",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tactiveLevel = level",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\ttierIndex = i + 1 // 1-based for display (L1, L2, ...)",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif activeLevel == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn &amp;StopLossSignal{Triggered: false} // no level activated yet",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Check if price has retraced beyond trailing percent",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar stopPrice float64",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif position.Side == \"long\" {",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tstopPrice = highestPrice * (1 - activeLevel.TrailingPercent/100)",
            "lineNumber": 177
          }
        ]
      },

          },

          {

          {
            "text": "// StopLossChecker checks if stop loss conditions are met",

          },

            "text": "&#96; + \"&#96;&#96;&#96;\" + &#96;",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "### Field Descriptions",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "- **symbol**: Trading pair (required)",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "- **action**: Action type (required)",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "  - HOLD: Hold current position",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "  - PARTIAL_CLOSE: Partially close position",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "  - FULL_CLOSE: Fully close position",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "  - ADD_POSITION: Add to existing position",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "  - OPEN_NEW: Open new position",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "  - WAIT: Wait, take no action",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "- **leverage**: Leverage multiplier (required for new positions)",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "- **position_size_usd**: Position size in USDT (required for new positions)",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "- **stop_loss**: Stop-loss price (recommended for new positions)",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "- **take_profit**: Take-profit price (recommended for new positions)",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "- **confidence**: Confidence level (0-100)",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "- **reasoning**: Detailed reasoning (required, must explain decision basis)",
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "## Critical Reminders",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Let strategy handle SL/TP**: Trailing stop, ATR stop, scaled TP will execute automatically; no need for you to recommend closing",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Only close in extreme cases**: Unless there's clear structural break or multi-timeframe reversal, hold and let strategy manage",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Avoid frequent trading**: Frequent entries/exits in ranging markets accumulate fees and hurt overall returns",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Use OI to validate trends**: Open interest changes reveal true capital flow better than price alone",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (c *StopLossChecker) checkATRStop(position *PositionInfo, currentPrice float64, atr, atrLong float64) *StopLossSignal {",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "\tentryPrice := position.EntryPrice",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "\tmultiplierMin := getFloat64Value(c.config.ATRMultiplierMin, 1.5)",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "\tmultiplierMax := getFloat64Value(c.config.ATRMultiplierMax, 3.5)",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "\tmultiplier := (multiplierMin + multiplierMax) / 2",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// High volatility: use max multiplier so stop is further away (more tolerant)",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif atrLong &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; c.config.ATRToleranceEnabled != nil &amp;&amp; *c.config.ATRToleranceEnabled {",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\thighMult := getFloat64Value(c.config.ATRHighMultiplier, 1.2)",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif atr &gt; atrLong*highMult {",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tmultiplier = multiplierMax",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar stopPrice float64",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif position.Side == \"long\" {",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tstopPrice = entryPrice - (atr * multiplier)",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif currentPrice &lt;= stopPrice {",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn &amp;StopLossSignal{",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tTriggered: true,",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tReason:    fmt.Sprintf(\"ATR stop loss triggered: %.2fx ATR below entry\", multiplier),",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tPrice:     stopPrice,",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tType:      \"atr\",",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "\t} else { // short",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tstopPrice = entryPrice + (atr * multiplier)",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif currentPrice &gt;= stopPrice {",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn &amp;StopLossSignal{",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tTriggered: true,",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tReason:    fmt.Sprintf(\"ATR stop loss triggered: %.2fx ATR above entry\", multiplier),",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tPrice:     stopPrice,",
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tType:      \"atr\",",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn &amp;StopLossSignal{Triggered: false}",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "// checkSupportResistanceStop checks support/resistance based stop loss",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "// Caller should pass: supportLevel for long positions, resistanceLevel for short positions",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "func (c *StopLossChecker) checkSupportResistanceStop(position *PositionInfo, currentPrice float64, srLevel float64) *StopLossSignal {",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "\tbuffer := getFloat64Value(c.config.SupportResistanceBuffer, 0.5)",
            "lineNumber": 253
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.19001460075378418

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\kernel\\take_profit.go",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 30,
            "column": 82
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 84,

          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (c *TakeProfitChecker) CheckTakeProfit(",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "\tposition *PositionInfo,",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcurrentPrice float64,",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "\tatr float64, // current ATR value",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "\tresistanceLevel float64, // resistance level (0 if not available)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": ") *TakeProfitSignal {",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c == nil || c.config == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn &amp;TakeProfitSignal{Triggered: false}",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsignals := make([]*TakeProfitSignal, 0)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. Check fixed take profit levels",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c.config.FixedEnabled != nil &amp;&amp; *c.config.FixedEnabled &amp;&amp; c.config.FixedPercent != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif signal := c.checkFixedTakeProfit(position, currentPrice); signal.Triggered {",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsignals = append(signals, signal)",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Check scaled take profit levels",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c.config.ScaledEnabled != nil &amp;&amp; *c.config.ScaledEnabled {",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif signal := c.checkScaledTakeProfit(position, currentPrice); signal.Triggered {",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsignals = append(signals, signal)",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 3. Check ATR-based take profit",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c.config.ATREnabled != nil &amp;&amp; *c.config.ATREnabled &amp;&amp; atr &gt; 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif signal := c.checkATRTakeProfit(position, currentPrice, atr); signal.Triggered {",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsignals = append(signals, signal)",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 4. Check resistance-based take profit",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c.config.ResistanceEnabled != nil &amp;&amp; *c.config.ResistanceEnabled &amp;&amp; resistanceLevel &gt; 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif signal := c.checkResistanceTakeProfit(position, currentPrice, resistanceLevel); signal.Triggered {",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsignals = append(signals, signal)",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Apply trigger logic",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif len(signals) == 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn &amp;TakeProfitSignal{Triggered: false}",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Default: \"any\" logic - any condition triggers = take profit",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Return first triggered signal",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn signals[0]",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "// checkFixedTakeProfit checks fixed take profit level",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "func (c *TakeProfitChecker) checkFixedTakeProfit(position *PositionInfo, currentPrice float64) *TakeProfitSignal {",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif c.config.FixedPercent == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn &amp;TakeProfitSignal{Triggered: false}",
            "lineNumber": 85
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.18968459963798523

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "\treturn nil",

          },
          {
