          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2083
          },
          {
            "text": "func validateDecision(d *Decision, accountEquity float64, btcEthLeverage, altcoinLeverage int, btcEthPosRatio, altcoinPosRatio float64) error {",
            "lineNumber": 2084
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvalidActions := map[string]bool{",
            "lineNumber": 2085
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\"open_long\":   true,",
            "lineNumber": 2086
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\"open_short\":  true,",
            "lineNumber": 2087
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\"close_long\":  true,",
            "lineNumber": 2088
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\"close_short\": true,",
            "lineNumber": 2089
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\"hold\":        true,",
            "lineNumber": 2090
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\"wait\":        true,",
            "lineNumber": 2091
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2092
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2093
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif !validActions[d.Action] {",
            "lineNumber": 2094
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"invalid action: %s\", d.Action)",
            "lineNumber": 2095
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2096
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2097
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif d.Action == \"open_long\" || d.Action == \"open_short\" {",
            "lineNumber": 2098
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tmaxLeverage := altcoinLeverage",
            "lineNumber": 2099
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tposRatio := altcoinPosRatio",
            "lineNumber": 2100
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tmaxPositionValue := accountEquity * posRatio",
            "lineNumber": 2101
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif d.Symbol == \"BTCUSDT\" || d.Symbol == \"ETHUSDT\" {",
            "lineNumber": 2102
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tmaxLeverage = btcEthLeverage",
            "lineNumber": 2103
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tposRatio = btcEthPosRatio",
            "lineNumber": 2104
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tmaxPositionValue = accountEquity * posRatio",
            "lineNumber": 2105
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2107
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif d.Leverage &lt;= 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 2108
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"leverage must be greater than 0: %d\", d.Leverage)",
            "lineNumber": 2109
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2110
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif d.Leverage &gt; maxLeverage {",
            "lineNumber": 2111
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tlogger.Infof(\"⚠️  [Leverage Fallback] %s leverage exceeded (%dx &gt; %dx), auto-adjusting to limit %dx\",",
            "lineNumber": 2112
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\td.Symbol, d.Leverage, maxLeverage, maxLeverage)",
            "lineNumber": 2113
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\td.Leverage = maxLeverage",
            "lineNumber": 2114
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2115
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif d.PositionSizeUSD &lt;= 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 2116
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"position size must be greater than 0: %.2f\", d.PositionSizeUSD)",
            "lineNumber": 2117
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2119
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tconst minPositionSizeGeneral = 12.0",
            "lineNumber": 2120
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tconst minPositionSizeBTCETH = 60.0",
            "lineNumber": 2121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2122
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif d.Symbol == \"BTCUSDT\" || d.Symbol == \"ETHUSDT\" {",
            "lineNumber": 2123
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tif d.PositionSizeUSD &lt; minPositionSizeBTCETH {",
            "lineNumber": 2124
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%s opening amount too small (%.2f USDT), must be ≥%.2f USDT\", d.Symbol, d.PositionSizeUSD, minPositionSizeBTCETH)",
            "lineNumber": 2125
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2126
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t} else {",
            "lineNumber": 2127
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tif d.PositionSizeUSD &lt; minPositionSizeGeneral {",
            "lineNumber": 2128
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"opening amount too small (%.2f USDT), must be ≥%.2f USDT\", d.PositionSizeUSD, minPositionSizeGeneral)",
            "lineNumber": 2129
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2130
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 2131
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2132
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\ttolerance := maxPositionValue * 0.01",
            "lineNumber": 2133
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif d.PositionSizeUSD &gt; maxPositionValue+tolerance {",
            "lineNumber": 2134
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tif d.Symbol == \"BTCUSDT\" || d.Symbol == \"ETHUSDT\"",
            "lineNumber": 2135
          }
        ]

    {
      "codeBlock": {

          "startPosition": {

          },

          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "\t// 回测只对 r.cfg.Symbols 拉行情（通常 3～5 个），实盘/模拟候选列表可能很多，故此处限制写入 prompt 的候选数，减轻 token 差距",
            "lineNumber": 422
          },
          {
            "text": "\tpositionSymbols := make(map[string]bool)",
            "lineNumber": 423
          },
          {
            "text": "\tfor _, pos := range ctx.Positions {",
            "lineNumber": 424
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tpositionSymbols[pos.Symbol] = true",
            "lineNumber": 425
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 426
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 427
          },
          {
            "text": "\tconst minOIThresholdMillions = 15.0  // 15M USD minimum open interest value",
            "lineNumber": 428
          },
          {
            "text": "\tconst maxCandidateCoinsForPrompt = 8 // 实盘/模拟 prompt 中最多纳入的候选币数（不含持仓），再大会导致 input token 远超回测",
            "lineNumber": 429
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 430
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcandidateCoinsAdded := 0",
            "lineNumber": 431
          },
          {
            "text": "\tfor _, coin := range ctx.CandidateCoins {",
            "lineNumber": 432
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif _, exists := ctx.MarketDataMap[coin.Symbol]; exists {",
            "lineNumber": 433
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tcontinue",
            "lineNumber": 434
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 435
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif positionSymbols[coin.Symbol] {",
            "lineNumber": 436
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tcontinue",

已按「震荡为主、趋势较少」的假设做了整体梳理，并做了小幅强化，总结如下。

---

## 1. 分析结论（详见 `docs/策略与代码结构_震荡市分析.md`）

### 当前策略与代码在震荡市下的表现

- **策略定位**：趋势跟踪（多周期共振 + OI/资金流确认才开仓）。
- **震荡处理**：
  - 多周期指南里：**观望 = 4h 震荡 或 各周期方向不一致**。
  - 入场标准里：**避免横盘震荡市场**。
  - 弱趋势/震荡：止盈用 2.5–3.0× ATR，快速止盈。
  - 场景 2（假突破）、场景 5（横盘观望）都教 AI 在震荡/假突破时 **wait**。
- **结论**：规则上已经偏向「震荡 = 少做/不做」，和「震荡为主」的假设是**一致**的。

### 主要风险与不足

- **震荡识别完全靠 AI**：没有用 ADX、布林宽度等客观指标在代码里强制「震荡」；若把震荡误判成趋势，仍可能开仓。
- **示例偏趋势**：趋势突破/止盈/止损等「有动作」的示例多，横盘 wait 的示例少，模型可能仍偏「总想做一笔」。
- **无按环境调参**：没有「震荡时提高开仓门槛」或「弱趋势减仓」的专门逻辑（仅能通过全局 MinConfidence 等调节）。

---

## 2. 已做的代码/文档改动

1. **新增分析文档**  
   `docs/策略与代码结构_震荡市分析.md` 包含：
   - 策略与代码结构概览；
   - 震荡市下的匹配度分析（做得好的点 + 不足）；
   - 各模块与震荡/趋势的对应关系；
   - 改进建议（Prompt/Schema、配置、可选震荡过滤器等）。

2. **强化「震荡优先、默认观望」**  
   - **Prompt**（`kernel/prompt_builder.go`）：在「顺势交易」下增加一句：  
     - 中文：**多数时间为震荡或方向不明，默认应以观望为主；仅当多周期与 OI 明确指向同一趋势时才考虑开仓。**  
     - 英文：**Most of the time the market is ranging or unclear; default to wait. Only consider opening when multi-timeframe and OI clearly point to the same trend.**  
   - **Schema**（`kernel/schema.go`）多时间框架「观望」条：  
     - 中文：**市场多数时间为震荡，4h 震荡时本周期一律观望，不开新仓。**  
     - 英文：**Markets are ranging most of the time; when 4h is sideways, wait and do not open new positions this cycle.**

这样在不改执行逻辑的前提下，把「震荡为主」明确写进规则，有利于在震荡市里减少无效开仓。

---

## 3. 后续可选项（文档里已写）

- 再增加 1 个「4h 震荡 + 1h 略偏多但未成势 → wait」的示例，提高 wait 的权重。
- 在 schema 里给「4h 震荡」一个更可执行的定义（如：价格在 4h EMA20 附近反复、MACD 近 0、区间幅度小于某比例）。
- 可选：用 4h ADX 或布林宽度做**震荡过滤器**，在上下文里注入「当前 4h 标记为震荡，请优先 wait」。
- 用震荡占比较高的历史区间做回测，验证开仓次数和亏损是否集中在「误判趋势」的少数几笔。

如果你希望，我可以再具体写「震荡示例」或「4h 震荡」的可执行定义文案，直接贴进 schema 的示例和规则里。

已按「震荡为主、拿住仓、盈利后平仓」的思路做了统一调整，摘要如下。

---

## 1. 目标澄清

- **不是**：震荡就少开仓 → 开仓机会很少。  
- **而是**：震荡市仍可开仓，重点是**拿住持仓**（不被区间内波动洗出去）和**盈利后平仓**（有利润就出，不赌大趋势）。

---

## 2. 文档更新（`docs/策略与代码结构_震荡市分析.md`）

新增 **「六、震荡市目标澄清：拿住持仓 + 盈利后平仓」**：

- **如何拿住仓**：止损不要太紧（震荡市用 2.0–2.5× ATR）、连续确认再止损、高波动宽容、最小持仓时间、初始兜底止损；并说明当前策略/代码已支持。
- **如何盈利后平仓**：止盈目标现实（2.5–3× ATR）、分层止盈、LockProfit、追踪止损；说明由现有逻辑执行。
- **震荡市开仓原则**：可在区间下沿附近做多、上沿附近做空；止损偏宽、止盈适中；持仓中交给系统执行，不因单根 K 线就平仓。

---

## 3. Schema（`kernel/schema.go`）

- **多时间框架「观望」**：从「4h 震荡一律观望」改为「4h 震荡且**无明确区间支撑/阻力**时观望；**若有清晰区间，可在区间下沿附近做多、上沿附近做空**」。
- **止损**：增加「**震荡市**」一条——建议 **2.0–2.5× ATR**，目的是拿住仓，避免被区间内波动洗出；并说明系统会连续确认再执行。
- **止盈**：在「弱趋势/震荡」处强调「**盈利后平仓**，不贪大趋势」；并增加「**震荡市操作（拿住仓 + 盈利后平仓）**」：区间边缘开仓、止损 2.0–2.5×、止盈 2.5–3.0× 或区间对侧，由分层止盈与 LockProfit 执行。

中英文两套说明都已按上述思路改完。

---

## 4. Prompt（`kernel/prompt_builder.go`）

- **顺势交易**：从「多数时间震荡则默认观望」改为「**震荡市仍可开仓**：有清晰区间时在区间下沿附近做多、上沿附近做空；目标是**拿住持仓**、**盈利后平仓**；止损用较宽 ATR（2.0–2.5×），止盈用适中目标（2.5–3× ATR）。」
- **耐心持仓**：补充「震荡市拿住仓，盈利后由分层止盈/追踪止损自动平仓」。

---

## 5. 策略预设（`store/strategy.go`）

- **避免以下情况**：从「横盘震荡市场」改为「**震荡区间中间或方向不明时追单**（震荡市可在区间下沿/上沿附近开仓，止损放宽拿住仓，止盈适中盈利后平仓）」。
- **观望条件**：对应一条改为「震荡区间中间或方向不明（区间边缘可开仓，拿住仓、盈利后平仓）」。

---

## 6. 行为小结

| 场景           | 之前倾向           | 现在倾向                                           |
|----------------|--------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| 4h 震荡        | 一律观望，少开仓   | 无区间则观望；有清晰区间则在边缘开仓               |

So the split would be:
- **Open:** AI predicts, decides direction (long/short), and defines dynamic params (SL, TP, ATR multiples, etc.)

Let me think through:

**Pros:**
1. Aligns with the experiment: when AI was not deciding to close (PIPPIN 6.8h hold), the trade was profitable; when AI was deciding to close (3 trades), they closed early with small losses.
2. In ranging markets, "holding through chop" and "exit in profit" are better achieved by fixed rules (trailing stop, scaled TP, lock profit) than by AI re-evaluating every cycle (AI tends to react to short-term noise and suggest close).
3. Simpler mental model: AI = entry + risk params; Strategy = exit. Reduces "AI second-guessing" and premature closes.
4. Strategy already has: ConfirmCycles, ATR tolerance, MinHoldMinutes, trailing, scaled TP, LockProfit — all designed to hold through chop and close in profit. Disabling AI close would let these run without override.

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func GetFullDecisionWithStrategy(ctx *Context, mcpClient mcp.AIClient, engine *StrategyEngine, variant, runID string) (*FullDecision, error) {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\tif ctx == nil {",

          {
            "text": "\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"context is nil\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif engine == nil {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tdefaultConfig := store.GetDefaultStrategyConfig(\"en\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tengine = NewStrategyEngine(&amp;defaultConfig)",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. Fetch market data using strategy config",

          },
          {
            "text": "\tif len(ctx.MarketDataMap) == 0 {",

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Ensure OITopDataMap is initialized",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif ctx.OITopDataMap == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tctx.OITopDataMap = make(map[string]*OITopData)",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\toiPositions, err := engine.nofxosClient.GetOITopPositions()",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif err == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tfor _, pos := range oiPositions {",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tctx.OITopDataMap[pos.Symbol] = &amp;OITopData{",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tRank:              pos.Rank,",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tOIDeltaPercent:    pos.OIDeltaPercent,",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Build System Prompt using strategy engine (includes Schema for caching)",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "\triskConfig := engine.GetRiskControlConfig()",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 3. Build User Prompt using strategy engine",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "\tuserPrompt := engine.BuildUserPrompt(ctx)",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 4. Call AI API with prompt caching enabled",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "\taiCallStart := time.Now()",

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\taiResponse,",
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tctx.Account.TotalEquity,",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\triskConfig.BTCETHMaxLeverage,",

          },

      "codeBlock": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (e *StrategyEngine) BuildSystemPrompt(accountEquity float64, variant string) string {",
            "lineNumber": 985
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar sb strings.Builder",
            "lineNumber": 986
          },
          {
            "text": "\triskControl := e.config.RiskControl",
            "lineNumber": 987
          },
          {
            "text": "\tpromptSections := e.config.PromptSections",
            "lineNumber": 988
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 989
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 0. Data Dictionary &amp; Schema (static content, will be cached)",
            "lineNumber": 990
          },
          {
            "text": "\tlang := e.GetLanguage()",
            "lineNumber": 991
          },
          {
            "text": "\tschemaPrompt := GetSchemaPrompt(lang)",
            "lineNumber": 992
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(schemaPrompt)",
            "lineNumber": 993
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 994
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"---\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 995
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 996
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. Role definition (editable)",
            "lineNumber": 997
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif promptSections.RoleDefinition != \"\" {",
            "lineNumber": 998
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(promptSections.RoleDefinition)",
            "lineNumber": 999
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1000
          },
          {
            "text": "\t} else {",
            "lineNumber": 1001
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"# You are a professional cryptocurrency trading AI\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1002
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"Your task is to make trading decisions based on provided market data.\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1003
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1004
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1005
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Trading mode variant",
            "lineNumber": 1006
          },
          {
            "text": "\tswitch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(variant)) {",
            "lineNumber": 1007
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"aggressive\":",
            "lineNumber": 1008
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"## Mode: Aggressive\\n- Prioritize capturing trend breakouts, can build positions in batches when confidence ≥ 70\\n- Allow higher positions, but must strictly set stop-loss and explain risk-reward ratio\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1009
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"conservative\":",
            "lineNumber": 1010
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"## Mode: Conservative\\n- Only open positions when multiple signals resonate\\n- Prioritize cash preservation, must pause for multiple periods after consecutive losses\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1011
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"scalping\":",
            "lineNumber": 1012
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"## Mode: Scalping\\n- Focus on short-term momentum, smaller profit targets but require quick action\\n- If price doesn't move as expected within two bars, immediately reduce position or stop-loss\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1013
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1014
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1015
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 3. Hard constraints (risk control)",
            "lineNumber": 1016
          },
          {
            "text": "\tbtcEthPosValueRatio := riskControl.BTCETHMaxPositionValueRatio",
            "lineNumber": 1017
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif btcEthPosValueRatio &lt;= 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 1018
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tbtcEthPosValueRatio = 5.0",
            "lineNumber": 1019
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1020
          },
          {
            "text": "\taltcoinPosValueRatio := riskControl.AltcoinMaxPositionValueRatio",
            "lineNumber": 1021
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif altcoinPosValueRatio &lt;= 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 1022
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\taltcoinPosValueRatio = 1.0",
            "lineNumber": 1023
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1024
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1025
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"# Hard Constraints (Risk Control)\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1026
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"## CODE ENFORCED (Backend validation, cannot be bypassed):\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1027
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"- Max Positions: %d coins simultaneously\\n\", riskControl.MaxPositions))",
            "lineNumber": 1028
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString",
            "lineNumber": 1029
          }
        ]

          {
            "text": "func callAIWithCaching(mcpClient mcp.AIClient, systemPrompt, userPrompt, runID string) (string, error) {",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Try to use the advanced Request API with caching",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// If the client doesn't support it, fall back to simple CallWithMessages",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Build request with caching enabled for system prompt",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsystemMsg := mcp.NewSystemMessageWithCache(systemPrompt)",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "\tuserMsg := mcp.NewUserMessage(userPrompt)",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49

          {
            "text": "\treq, buildErr := mcp.NewRequestBuilder().",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tAddMessage(systemMsg).",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tAddMessage(userMsg).",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tWithStream(true). // 流式输出，避免思维链等长输出受单次响应长度限制",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tBuild()",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif buildErr != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tlogger.Infof(\"⚠️  Request build failed, falling back to simple API: %v\", buildErr)",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn mcpClient.CallWithMessages(systemPrompt, userPrompt)",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "\treq.RunID = runID",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Try to call with Request API (supports caching)",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "\tresult, err := mcpClient.CallWithRequest(req)",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif err != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t// If Request API fails, fall back to simple API",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tlogger.Infof(\"⚠️  Request API failed, falling back to simple API: %v\", err)",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "\t",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },

          {
            "text": "\t// Safe regex: precisely match &#96;&#96;&#96;json code blocks",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\kernel\\prompt_builder.go",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 195,

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "func (pb *PromptBuilder) buildSystemPromptEN() string {",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn &#96;You are a professional quantitative trading AI assistant responsible for analyzing market data and making trading decisions.",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "## Your Mission",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Analyze Account Status**: Evaluate current risk level, margin usage, and positions",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Analyze Current Positions**: Assess if trend continues, check for structural breaks",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Analyze Candidate Coins**: Assess new trading opportunities using technical analysis and capital flows",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Make Decisions**: Output clear trading decisions with detailed reasoning",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "## ⚠️ Core Principle: Stop-Loss/Take-Profit is Executed by Strategy",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "**The system has configured dynamic SL/TP strategies** (trailing stop, ATR stop, scaled take-profit). These strategies automatically monitor and execute closes.",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "### Division of Responsibilities",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Your job**: Determine trend direction, choose entry timing, assess risk, decide whether to open new positions",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Strategy's job**: Automatically execute stop-loss/take-profit (trailing stop, ATR stop, scaled TP); execution uses confirm cycles and is more tolerant in high volatility—do not recommend closing solely because one bar touched the stop level. On structure break (e.g. 1h close below/above EMA20) you may recommend closing to reduce loss; on clear reversal you may close then open the opposite direction in the same plan.",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "### Closing Existing Positions",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Default to HOLD**: Unless there are extreme signals, let the strategy manage SL/TP automatically",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Only recommend closing in these extreme cases**:",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. Key support/resistance broken, or **1h close below EMA20 (longs) / above EMA20 (shorts)**—structure break, close early to reduce loss",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. Multi-timeframe (1h+4h) trend reversal simultaneously",
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. Major bearish news or black swan event",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "  4. Extreme RSI overbought(&gt;85)/oversold(&lt;15) + volume divergence",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Flip on clear reversal**: If multi-timeframe and OI clearly reversed, in the same plan you may output close_long then open_short (or close_short then open_long) for that symbol; system executes close first then open; set new SL/TP for the new position",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Do NOT close for these reasons**:",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Short-term oscillation or normal pullback",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Floating loss within strategy's stop-loss range",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Just \"feeling risky\" without specific technical signals",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "## Decision Principles",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "### Risk First",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "- Margin usage must not exceed 30%",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "- Capital protection first, profit second",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "### Trend Following",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "- **In ranging markets you can still open**: When there is a clear range (support/resistance), open long near the range low and short near the range high. Goal: **hold the position** (don't get stopped out by range noise) and **exit in profit** (don't chase a big trend). Use wider stop (2.0-2.5× ATR) to survive chop, and modest TP (2.5-3× ATR) to take profit when reached.",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "- In trending markets: only consider opening when multi-timeframe and OI clearly align.",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "- Use Open Interest (OI) changes to validate capital flow authenticity",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "- OI up + Price up = Strong bullish trend",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "- OI down + Price up = Shorts covering (potential reversal)",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "### Patient Holding",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "- After opening, trust the strategy; don't trade frequently due to short-term volatility",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "- Frequent trading in ranging markets accumulates fee losses; **in ranging markets hold through chop and let scaled TP / trailing stop close in profit**",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "- Let profits run; let trailing stop lock in profits",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "text": "## Output Format Requirements",
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "**Must** use the following JSON format:",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96; + \"&#96;&#96;&#96;json\" + &#96;",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "[",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "  {",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"symbol\": \"BTCUSDT\",",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"action\": \"HOLD|PARTIAL_CLOSE|FULL_CLOSE|ADD_POSITION|OPEN_NEW|WAIT\",",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"leverage\": 3,",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"position_size_usd\": 1000,",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"stop_loss\": 42000,",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"take_profit\": 48000,",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"confidence\": 85,",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"reasoning\": \"Detailed reasoning explaining why this decision was made\"",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "  }",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "text": "]",
            "lineNumber": 263
          }
        ]
      },

          {
            "text": "// ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 472
          },
          {
            "text": "// Candidate Coins",
            "lineNumber": 473
          },
          {
            "text": "// ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 474
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 475
          },
          {
            "text": "// GetCandidateCoins gets candidate coins based on strategy configuration",
            "lineNumber": 476
          },
          {
            "text": "func (e *StrategyEngine) GetCandidateCoins() ([]CandidateCoin, error) {",
            "lineNumber": 477
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar candidates []CandidateCoin",
            "lineNumber": 478
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsymbolSources := make(map[string][]string)",
            "lineNumber": 479
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 480
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcoinSource := e.config.CoinSource",
            "lineNumber": 481
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 482
          },
          {
            "text": "\tswitch coinSource.SourceType {",
            "lineNumber": 483
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"static\":",
            "lineNumber": 484
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tfor _, symbol := range coinSource.StaticCoins {",
            "lineNumber": 485
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsymbol = market.Normalize(symbol)",
            "lineNumber": 486
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tcandidates = append(candidates, CandidateCoin{",
            "lineNumber": 487
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tSymbol:  symbol,",
            "lineNumber": 488
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tSources: []string{\"static\"},",
            "lineNumber": 489
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t})",
            "lineNumber": 490
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 491
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 492
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn e.filterExcludedCoins(candidates), nil",
            "lineNumber": 493
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 494
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"ai500\":",
            "lineNumber": 495
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t// 检查 use_ai500 标志，如果为 false 则回退到静态币种",
            "lineNumber": 496
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif !coinSource.UseAI500 {",
            "lineNumber": 497
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tlogger.Infof(\"⚠️  source_type is 'ai500' but use_ai500 is false, falling back to static coins\")",
            "lineNumber": 498
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tfor _, symbol := range coinSource.StaticCoins {",
            "lineNumber": 499
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tsymbol = market.Normalize(symbol)",
            "lineNumber": 500
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tcandidates = append(candidates, CandidateCoin{",
            "lineNumber": 501
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tSymbol:  symbol,",
            "lineNumber": 502
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tSources: []string{\"static\"},",
            "lineNumber": 503
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t})",
            "lineNumber": 504
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 505
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn e.filterExcludedCoins(candidates), nil",
            "lineNumber": 506
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 507
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tcoins, err := e.getAI500Coins(coinSource.AI500Limit)",
            "lineNumber": 508
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif err != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 509
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\treturn nil, err",
            "lineNumber": 510
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 511
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t// 空列表是正常情况，直接返回",
            "lineNumber": 512
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn e.filterExcludedCoins(coins), nil",
            "lineNumber": 513
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 514
          },
          {
            "text": "\tcase \"oi_top\":",
            "lineNumber": 515
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t// 检查 use_oi_top 标志，如果为 false 则回退到静态币种",
            "lineNumber": 516
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif !coinSource.UseOITop {",
            "lineNumber": 517
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tlogger.Infof",
            "lineNumber": 518
          }
        ]
      },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "// Decision AI trading decision",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "type Decision struct {",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "\tSymbol string &#96;json:\"symbol\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "\tAction string &#96;json:\"action\"&#96; // Standard: \"open_long\", \"open_short\", \"close_long\", \"close_short\", \"hold\", \"wait\"",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Grid actions: \"place_buy_limit\", \"place_sell_limit\", \"cancel_order\", \"cancel_all_orders\", \"pause_grid\", \"resume_grid\", \"adjust_grid\"",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Opening position parameters",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Common parameters",

          },
          {
            "text": "\tConfidence int     &#96;json:\"confidence,omitempty\"&#96; // Confidence level (0-100)",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },

          },
          {
            "text": "\tReasoning  string  &#96;json:\"reasoning\"&#96;",

          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "// FullDecision AI's complete decision (including chain of thought)",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "type FullDecision struct {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\tSystemPrompt        string     &#96;json:\"system_prompt\"&#96;",

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 208
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {

          {
            "text": "\treturn sb.String()",

            "lineNumber": 1412
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1413
          },
          {
            "text": "func (e *StrategyEngine) formatPositionInfo(index int, pos PositionInfo, ctx *Context) string {",
            "lineNumber": 1414
          },
          {
            "text": "\tvar sb strings.Builder",
            "lineNumber": 1415
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1416
          },
          {
            "text": "\tholdingDuration := \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 1417
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif pos.UpdateTime &gt; 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 1418
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tdurationMs := time.Now().UnixMilli() - pos.UpdateTime",
            "lineNumber": 1419
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tdurationMin := durationMs / (1000 * 60)",
            "lineNumber": 1420
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif durationMin &lt; 60 {",
            "lineNumber": 1421
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tholdingDuration = fmt.Sprintf(\" | Holding Duration %d min\", durationMin)",
            "lineNumber": 1422
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t} else {",
            "lineNumber": 1423
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tdurationHour := durationMin / 60",
            "lineNumber": 1424
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tdurationMinRemainder := durationMin % 60",
            "lineNumber": 1425
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tholdingDuration = fmt.Sprintf(\" | Holding Duration %dh %dm\", durationHour, durationMinRemainder)",
            "lineNumber": 1426
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1427
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1428
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1429
          },
          {
            "text": "\tpositionValue := pos.Quantity * pos.MarkPrice",
            "lineNumber": 1430
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif positionValue &lt; 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 1431
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tpositionValue = -positionValue",
            "lineNumber": 1432
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1433
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1434
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"%d. %s %s | Entry %.4f Current %.4f | Qty %.4f | Position Value %.2f USDT | PnL%+.2f%% | PnL Amount%+.2f USDT | Peak PnL%.2f%% | Leverage %dx | Margin %.0f | Liq Price %.4f%s\\n\\n\",",
            "lineNumber": 1435
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tindex, pos.Symbol, strings.ToUpper(pos.Side),",
            "lineNumber": 1436
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tpos.EntryPrice, pos.MarkPrice, pos.Quantity, positionValue, pos.UnrealizedPnLPct, pos.UnrealizedPnL, pos.PeakPnLPct,",
            "lineNumber": 1437
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tpos.Leverage, pos.MarginUsed, pos.LiquidationPrice, holdingDuration))",
            "lineNumber": 1438
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1439
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif marketData, ok := ctx.MarketDataMap[pos.Symbol]; ok {",
            "lineNumber": 1440
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(e.formatMarketData(marketData))",
            "lineNumber": 1441
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1442
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif ctx.QuantDataMap != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 1443
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tif quantData, hasQuant := ctx.QuantDataMap[pos.Symbol]; hasQuant {",
            "lineNumber": 1444
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tsb.WriteString(e.formatQuantData(quantData))",
            "lineNumber": 1445
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1446
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1447
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1448
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1449
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1450
          },
          {
            "text": "\treturn sb.String()",
            "lineNumber": 1451
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 1452
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1453
          },
          {
            "text": "// formatStrategyDynamicSLTP returns a short summary of strategy dynamic SL/TP for the AI prompt,",
            "lineNumber": 1454
          },
          {
            "text": "// so reasoning can explicitly mention 初始止损、止盈、ATR倍数/周期 and that 追踪止损/分层止盈由策略执行.",
            "lineNumber": 1455
          },
          {
            "text": "func (e *StrategyEngine) formatStrategyDynamicSLTP() string {",
            "lineNumber": 1456
          },
          {
            "text": "\trc := e.config.RiskControl",
            "lineNumber": 1457
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsl := rc.DynamicStopLoss",
            "lineNumber": 1458
          }
        ]
      },

          },

            "text": "\tswitch e.config.Language {",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "// GetConfig gets complete strategy configuration",

          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "// ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "// Entry Functions - Main API",

          },
          {
            "text": "// ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "// GetFullDecision gets AI's complete trading decision (batch analysis of all coins and positions)",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "// Uses default strategy configuration - for production use GetFullDecisionWithStrategy with explicit config",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          {
            "text": "\treturn GetFullDecisionWithStrategy(ctx, mcpClient, engine, \"\", \"\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "// GetFullDecisionWithStrategy uses StrategyEngine to get AI decision (unified prompt generation).",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "// runID is optional (e.g. backtest run_id); when set, token usage is stored per-run for GET /api/ai-usage?run_id=",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "func GetFullDecisionWithStrategy(ctx *Context, mcpClient mcp.AIClient, engine *StrategyEngine, variant, runID string) (*FullDecision, error) {",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif ctx == nil {",

          {
            "text": "\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"context is nil\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",

          }
        ]

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "\tif len(ctx.RecentOrders) &gt; 0 {",

          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(\"## Recent Completed Trades\\n\")",

          },

            "text": "\t\t\t}",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"%d. %s %s | Entry %.4f Exit %.4f | %s: %+.2f USDT (%+.2f%%) | %s→%s (%s)\\n\",",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1276
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "\tif ctx.TradingStats != nil &amp;&amp; ctx.TradingStats.TotalTrades &gt; 0 {",

            "text": "  }",

          },

            "text": "]",
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96; + \"&#96;&#96;&#96;\" + &#96;",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "### Field Descriptions",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "- **symbol**: Trading pair (required)",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "- **action**: Action type (required)",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "  - HOLD: Hold current position",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "  - PARTIAL_CLOSE: Partially close position",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "  - FULL_CLOSE: Fully close position",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "  - ADD_POSITION: Add to existing position",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "  - OPEN_NEW: Open new position",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "  - WAIT: Wait, take no action",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "- **leverage**: Leverage multiplier (required for new positions)",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "- **position_size_usd**: Position size in USDT (required for new positions)",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "- **stop_loss**: Stop-loss price (recommended for new positions)",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "- **take_profit**: Take-profit price (recommended for new positions)",
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "- **confidence**: Confidence level (0-100)",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "- **reasoning**: Detailed reasoning (required, must explain decision basis)",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "## Critical Reminders",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Let strategy handle SL/TP**: Trailing stop, ATR stop, scaled TP will execute automatically; no need for you to recommend closing",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Only close in extreme cases**: Unless there's clear structural break or multi-timeframe reversal, hold and let strategy manage",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Avoid frequent trading**: Frequent entries/exits in ranging markets accumulate fees and hurt overall returns",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Use OI to validate trends**: Open interest changes reveal true capital flow better than price alone",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Focus on entry quality**: Your core value is selecting good entry opportunities, not frequent stop-loss/take-profit",
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "Now, please carefully analyze the trading data provided next and make professional decisions.&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 293
          },

            "text": "func (pb *PromptBuilder) getDecisionRequirementsEN() string",
            "lineNumber": 294
          }

          {

---

## 1. 怎么设参数，能让 AI 有足够数据做趋势判断？

### K 线数量（你截图里的「K线数量」）

- **当前若为 20**：建议改为 **≥50**（推荐 **50**，想要更长趋势可 **80～100**）。
- **原因**：  
  - 4h 只有 20 根 ≈ 3.3 天，偏短；50 根 4h ≈ 8 天，更利于判断 4h 趋势。  
  - EMA50、MACD 等需要一定长度历史，50 根能保证各周期指标都有有效值。

### 技术指标参数（和你截图对应）

| 指标 | 建议 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| **EMA** | **20, 50** | 与提示词里「EMA20」「EMA50」一致，用于趋势和结构破坏。 |
| **RSI** | **7, 14** | 与提示词里 RSI7/RSI14、超买超卖一致。 |
| **MACD** | 留空或默认即可 | 后端固定 (12,26,9)，无需在策略里改。 |
| **ATR** | **14** 或 **3, 14** | 策略/Schema 里写的是「ATR周期 14」，保持一致。 |
| **BOLL** | **20** | 与常见 20 周期布林表述一致。 |

### 时间周期

- 至少勾选 **15m、1h、4h**，主周期用 15m（或 5m）即可。  
- 这样和提示词里「4h 定方向、1h 确认、15m 入场」一致，AI 才有对应周期的数据做趋势判断。

---

## 2. 参数设置后，策略和提示词要不要改？

- **只做下面这些时，策略和提示词都不用改**：  
  - 把 **K 线数量** 调到 50（或 80～100）；  
  - 指标保持 **EMA 20,50、RSI 7,14、ATR 14、BOLL 20**，MACD 用默认。  
- **只有在你改指标周期或时间框架时，才需要同步改**：  
  - 例如把 EMA 改成 10,30：Schema/策略/提示词里所有「EMA20」「EMA50」都要改成「EMA10」「EMA30」。  
  - 例如去掉 4h：提示词里「4h 定方向」等就要改成 1h 定方向或相应调整。

结论：**按上面推荐设「K线数量 + 指标 + 时间周期」即可让 AI 有足够数据做趋势判断，且无需改策略和提示词；只有当你自定义指标周期或周期组合时，才需要一起改策略和提示词。**

---

## 1. K 线数量=20 是合理选择

在优先控制 **AI 大模型 token 长度和费用** 的前提下，把 **K 线数量设为 20** 没问题，不需要为了“更多数据”而强行改成 50。

---

## 2. 为什么 20 根仍能支持趋势判断？

- **指标当前值**：后端是用 **200 根** K 线算 EMA/MACD/RSI/ATR 等，再和「最近 20 根」一起给 AI。所以**最新一根的指标值是建立在 200 根上的**，不会因为只发 20 根就失效。
- **多周期趋势**：Prompt 里已经带了每个标的的 **1h / 4h 涨跌幅**（多周期涨跌），也是后端按更长区间算的，用来做「1h/4h 偏多/偏空」的定性，可以和 20 根 K 线一起做趋势判断。
- **20 根的作用**：20 根 4h ≈ 3.3 天、20 根 1h ≈ 20 小时，对「近期结构 + 当前状态」一般够用；更长的趋势可以交给「当前指标 + 1h/4h 涨跌幅」一起看。

因此：**在 K=20、优先省 token 的前提下，趋势判断主要依靠「当前指标（基于 200 根）+ 1h/4h 涨跌幅」**，不必为了“足够数据”而提高 K 线数量。

---

## 3. 文档已做的修改

在 **`docs/技术指标与K线参数设置说明.md`** 里已：

- 标明 K 线数量=20 是 **Token/费用优先** 下的合理设置；
- 说明后端用 200 根算指标、以及 1h/4h 涨跌幅的用法；
- 在「推荐配置小结」里把 **20** 列为推荐之一（Token 优先），50～80 列为可选（更看重长序列时）；
- 统一结论：**保持 K=20 时，策略与提示词都不用改**。

之后若有人问「为什么用 20 不用 50」，可以直接引用该文档里「K 线数量=20 时（Token/费用优先）」这一节的说明。

是的，**已经全部实现**，并且配置、提示词和执行逻辑是对齐的。下面按「是怎样变的」简单总结。

---

## 1. 已实现的部分

| 层级 | 状态 | 位置 |
|------|------|------|
| **配置** | ✅ | `store/strategy.go`：`RiskControlConfig.AIOnlyEntry`（`ai_only_entry`） |
| **执行** | ✅ | `trader/auto_trader.go`：`ai_only_entry==true` 时不执行 AI 的 close_long/close_short |
| **提示词** | ✅ | `kernel/engine.go`：同一配置下注入「仅开仓、对已有仓一律 hold」的说明 |
| **前端** | ✅ | `RiskControlEditor.tsx`：「AI 仅开仓」勾选 + 说明文案 |

整体逻辑和提示词都已按「AI 只开仓、策略负责平仓」做了对应改动。

---

## 2. 是怎样变的（按执行顺序）

**① 配置**

- 在策略的 **风控配置** 里增加 `ai_only_entry`（前端即「AI 仅开仓」）。
- 默认不勾选时为 `false`，行为与原来一致；勾选并保存后为 `true`，该策略下交易员进入「仅开仓」模式。

**② 提示词**

- 在 **BuildUserPrompt**（`kernel/engine.go`）里，**仅当** `RiskControl.AIOnlyEntry == true` 时，在 User Prompt 里追加一段（中/英各一）：
  - 大意：当前是「AI 仅开仓」模式，你只负责预测、开仓方向和开仓时的止损/止盈参数；**所有已有持仓一律输出 hold，不要输出 close_long 或 close_short**，平仓由策略（动态止损、追踪止损、分层止盈）执行。

这样模型在「仅开仓」模式下会被明确要求：对已有仓只给 hold，不给平仓指令。

**③ 执行**

- 在 **runCycle**（`trader/auto_trader.go`）里，每条 AI 决策在执行前：
  - 若当前策略 `ai_only_entry == true` 且该条是 `close_long` 或 `close_short`：
    - **不执行**这条平仓（不调用 `executeCloseLongWithRecord` / `executeCloseShortWithRecord`），
    - 只打日志并记入 ExecutionLog：`"AI close xxx skipped (ai_only_entry=true, strategy handles exit)"`，然后 `continue`。
  - 其他动作（open_long、open_short、hold、wait）照常执行。

也就是说：**即使用户没勾选、或模型仍输出 close，只要策略里开了「AI 仅开仓」，执行层就不会执行任何 AI 的平仓单**；平仓只来自策略的动态止损/止盈等。

---

## 3. 和原来行为的对比

| 项目 | 原来（未开「AI 仅开仓」） | 现在（勾选「AI 仅开仓」） |
|------|---------------------------|----------------------------|
| 提示词 | 无「仅开仓」约束 | 多一段「仅开仓、对已有仓一律 hold」的约束 |
| AI 的 close_long/close_short | 经 2 周期确认后会执行 | **一律不执行**，只记日志 |
| 实际平仓来源 | AI 建议平仓 + 策略 SL/TP | **只有**策略 SL/TP（及手动/同步等） |

Schema 里关于「平仓建议」「结构破坏即减仓」「反手」的说明没有删，只是执行层在「AI 仅开仓」模式下会忽略 AI 的平仓类动作。

---

## 4. 文档

在 **`docs/策略重构_AI仅开仓策略平仓.md`** 里已新增 **「七、整体代码逻辑与提示词对应关系（是怎样变的）」**，按配置 → 提示词 → 执行写了完整对应关系和对比表，方便以后查。

**结论**：  
「AI 只开仓、策略负责平仓」已经实现：配置、提示词、执行三者一致；**通过策略风控里勾选「AI 仅开仓」即可开启**，无需改代码。

已把整体分析写进 **`docs/最新策略与系统盈利性分析.md`**，这里是精简结论。

---

## 一、最新策略：代码逻辑与提示词

- **策略定位**：趋势跟踪 + 震荡市可在区间边缘开仓；AI 负责预测与开仓（可选「AI 仅开仓」），策略负责全部/主要平仓（动态 SL/TP、追踪、分层、LockProfit）。
- **代码**：`ai_only_entry` 为 true 时不执行 AI 的 close；动态 SL/TP 每 30s 检查，ConfirmCycles=2、MinHold=10min、高波动宽容、8% 兜底；开仓受 MaxPositions、MinConfidence、MinRiskRewardRatio 约束。
- **提示词/Schema**：多周期共振、OI/资金流、禁止逆势；震荡市区间开仓 + 止损 2.0–2.5×ATR、止盈 2.5–3×；结构破坏可平、反转可反手；AI 仅开仓模式下注入「对已有仓一律 hold」。

逻辑与文案已对齐，没有发现明显冲突。

---

## 二、参数设置是否合理

| 类别 | 结论 |
|------|------|
| **风控** | MaxPositions=3、MinConfidence=75（或 60）、MinRiskRewardRatio=3、AIOnlyEntry 可选 → **合理**，可按风格微调。 |
| **止损** | MinHold=10、InitialStop=8%、追踪 L1/L2、ATR 1.5–2.5×、ConfirmCycles=2、高波动宽容 → **合理**，和「拿住仓、少假跌破」一致。 |
| **止盈** | 分层 4%/7%/10%、LockProfit 2.5%、ATR 2.5–4× → **合理**，和「盈利后平仓」一致。 |

整体参数与现有文档（如 SL_TP_PARAMETER_ANALYSIS、震荡市分析）一致，**判定为合理**；若实盘某类行情反复吃亏，再针对性微调即可。

---

## 三、整体系统能否盈利

**不能保证盈利**：市场与模型都不确定，任何系统都无法保证长期必然盈利。

**从设计上，有利于提高盈利概率、控制回撤**：

- 开仓有门槛（多周期 + OI + 信心度 + R/R≥3），单笔质量更好。
- 震荡市有明确规则（区间开仓、拿住仓、盈利后平仓）+ 可选「AI 仅开仓」，和你的实验结论一致。
- 平仓规则化（追踪、分层、LockProfit、8% 兜底），减少过早止损和情绪化平仓。
- 参数与提示词、代码一致，便于回测和实盘验证。

**主要风险**：开仓质量依赖 AI、执行滑点与手续费、趋势反转时若只用策略止损可能回撤略大、数据/延迟影响等。

**建议**：在「合适行情 + 正确配置（如震荡市开 AI 仅开仓）+ 严守风控」下，用回测和小仓位实盘验证，再根据结果微调参数（MinConfidence、是否 AI 仅开仓等），而不是追求一次调参就永远盈利。

          {
            "text": "\tvar sb strings.Builder",

            "text": "\tindicators := e.config.Indicators",

          {
            "text": "\t// 明确标注币种",

          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"=== %s Market Data ===\\n\\n\", data.Symbol))",
            "lineNumber": 1622
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 多周期涨跌提示，便于先定趋势再定多空（减少逆势与入场时机误判）",
            "lineNumber": 1623
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif data.PriceChange1h != 0 || data.PriceChange4h != 0 {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif e.GetLanguage() == LangChinese {",
            "lineNumber": 1625
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"多周期涨跌: 1h %+.2f%% 4h %+.2f%%（负=偏空 正=偏多，供趋势参考）\\n\\n\", data.PriceChange1h, data.PriceChange4h))",
            "lineNumber": 1626
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t} else {",
            "lineNumber": 1627
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"Multi-timeframe: 1h %+.2f%% 4h %+.2f%% (negative=bearish, positive=bullish, for trend reference)\\n\\n\", data.PriceChange1h, data.PriceChange4h))",
            "lineNumber": 1628
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1629
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1630
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"current_price = %.4f\", data.CurrentPrice))",
            "lineNumber": 1631
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1632
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif indicators.EnableEMA {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\", current_ema20 = %.3f\", data.CurrentEMA20))",
            "lineNumber": 1634
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1635
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1636
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif indicators.EnableMACD {",
            "lineNumber": 1637
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\", current_macd = %.3f\", data.CurrentMACD))",
            "lineNumber": 1638
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1639
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1640
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif indicators.EnableRSI {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\", current_rsi7 = %.3f\", data.CurrentRSI7))",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 1643
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1644
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(\"\\n\\n\")",
            "lineNumber": 1645
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1646
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif indicators.EnableOI || indicators.EnableFundingRate {",

          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1649
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif indicators.EnableOI &amp;&amp; data.OpenInterest != nil {",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1654
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1659
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif len(data.TimeframeData) &gt; 0 {",

          },
          {
            "text": "// Market Data Fetching",

          },
          {
            "text": "// ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "// fetchMarketDataWithStrategy fetches market data using strategy config (multiple timeframes)",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "func fetchMarketDataWithStrategy(ctx *Context, engine *StrategyEngine) error {",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "\tconfig := engine.GetConfig()",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "\tctx.MarketDataMap = make(map[string]*market.Data)",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "\ttimeframes := config.Indicators.Klines.SelectedTimeframes",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "\tprimaryTimeframe := config.Indicators.Klines.PrimaryTimeframe",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "\tklineCount := config.Indicators.Klines.PrimaryCount",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Compatible with old configuration",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif len(timeframes) == 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif primaryTimeframe != \"\" {",
            "lineNumber": 393
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\ttimeframes = append(timeframes, primaryTimeframe)",
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t} else {",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\ttimeframes = append(timeframes, \"3m\")",
            "lineNumber": 396
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 397
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif config.Indicators.Klines.LongerTimeframe != \"\" {",
            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\ttimeframes = append(timeframes, config.Indicators.Klines.LongerTimeframe)",
            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 401
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif primaryTimeframe == \"\" {",
            "lineNumber": 402
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tprimaryTimeframe = timeframes[0]",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif klineCount &lt;= 0 {",
            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tklineCount = 30",
            "lineNumber": 406
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "text": "\tlogger.Infof(\"📊 Strategy timeframes: %v, Primary: %s, Kline count: %d\", timeframes, primaryTimeframe, klineCount)",
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. First fetch data for position coins (must fetch)",
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "text": "\tfor _, pos := range ctx.Positions {",
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tdata, err := market.GetWithTimeframes(pos.Symbol, timeframes, primaryTimeframe, klineCount)",
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif err != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tlogger.Infof(\"⚠️  Failed to fetch market data for position %s: %v\", pos.Symbol, err)",
            "lineNumber": 415
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tcontinue",
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 417
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tctx.MarketDataMap[pos.Symbol] = data",
            "lineNumber": 418
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 419
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 420
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Fetch data for candidate coins (cap count to control prompt size / token usage)",
            "lineNumber": 421
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 回测只对 r.cfg.Symbols 拉行情（通常 3～5 个），实盘/模拟候选列表可能很多，故此处限制写入 prompt 的候选数，减轻 token 差距",
            "lineNumber": 422
          },
          {
            "text": "\tpositionSymbols := make(map[string]bool)",
            "lineNumber": 423
          }
        ]
      },

          {
            "text": "\tfor _, pos := range ctx.Positions {",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1386
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Get language for market data formatting",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },
          {

          {
            "text": "func GetFullDecisionWithStrategy(ctx *Context, mcpClient mcp.AIClient, engine *StrategyEngine, variant, runID string) (*FullDecision, error) {",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif ctx == nil {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif engine == nil {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tdefaultConfig := store.GetDefaultStrategyConfig(\"en\")",

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 1. Fetch market data using strategy config",

          },
          {
            "text": "\tif len(ctx.MarketDataMap) == 0 {",

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// Ensure OITopDataMap is initialized",

          },
          {
            "text": "\tif ctx.OITopDataMap == nil {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tctx.OITopDataMap = make(map[string]*OITopData)",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },

            "text": "\t\toiPositions, err := engine.nofxosClient.GetOITopPositions()",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tif err == nil {",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\tfor _, pos := range oiPositions {",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\tctx.OITopDataMap[pos.Symbol] = &amp;OITopData{",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tRank:              pos.Rank,",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tOIDeltaPercent:    pos.OIDeltaPercent,",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tOIDeltaValue:      pos.OIDeltaValue,",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t\tPriceDeltaPercent: pos.PriceDeltaPercent,",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\t}",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "\t}",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 2. Build System Prompt using strategy engine (includes Schema for caching)",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "\triskConfig := engine.GetRiskControlConfig()",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "\tsystemPrompt := engine.BuildSystemPrompt(ctx.Account.TotalEquity, variant)",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 3. Build User Prompt using strategy engine",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "\tuserPrompt := engine.BuildUserPrompt(ctx)",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 4. Call AI API with prompt caching enabled",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "\taiCallStart := time.Now()",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "\taiResponse, err := callAIWithCaching(mcpClient, systemPrompt, userPrompt, runID)",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "\taiCallDuration := time.Since(aiCallStart)",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "\tif err != nil {",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"AI API call failed: %w\", err)",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "text": "\t// 5. Parse AI response",

          },
          {
            "text": "\tdecision, err := parseFullDecisionResponse(",
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\taiResponse,",
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "\t\tctx.Account.TotalEquity,",

          },
          {
            "text": "\t\triskConfig.BTCETHMaxLeverage,",

          },

          },

          {

          {
            "text": "\tsb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(\"%d. %s %s | Entry %.4f Current %.4f | Qty %.4f | Position Value %.2f USDT | PnL%+.2f%% | PnL Amount%+.2f USDT | Peak PnL%.2f%% | Leverage %dx | Margin %.0f | Liq Price %.4f%s\\n\\n\",",

          },

          },

            "text": "- **take_profit**: Take-profit price (recommended for new positions)",

          },

            "text": "- **confidence**: Confidence level (0-100)",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "- **reasoning**: Detailed reasoning (required, must explain decision basis)",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "## Critical Reminders",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Let strategy handle SL/TP**: Trailing stop, ATR stop, scaled TP will execute automatically; no need for you to recommend closing",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Only close in extreme cases**: Unless there's clear structural break or multi-timeframe reversal, hold and let strategy manage",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Avoid frequent trading**: Frequent entries/exits in ranging markets accumulate fees and hurt overall returns",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Use OI to validate trends**: Open interest changes reveal true capital flow better than price alone",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Focus on entry quality**: Your core value is selecting good entry opportunities, not frequent stop-loss/take-profit",
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "Now, please carefully analyze the trading data provided next and make professional decisions.&#96;",
